applicabilityBasis.summary: Telcoin's eXYZ terms identify Telcoin LLC as the issuer of eMXN and describe fiat or currency-equivalent reserves with 1:1 redemption for eligible verified account holders. Telcoin Digital Asset Bank's eUSD is governed by separate bank terms; the bank charter is not evidence of authorization for eMXN.

references.label: Telcoin eXYZ terms: Telcoin LLC issuer, reserves and redemption

genius.notes: Review on 2026-10-07: binding eXYZ terms identify Telcoin LLC as eMXN issuer and describe its U.S. Money Services Business registration, segregated fiat/currency-equivalent reserves and 1:1 redemption for eligible account holders, less fees. They explicitly exclude eUSD, issued by Telcoin Inc. (Telcoin Digital Asset Bank) under separate terms. The affiliate Nebraska DADI charter and eUSD GENIUS-related product plans do not establish an eMXN issuing pathway or approval. No public eMXN/Telcoin LLC GENIUS approval or official application was located in the scoped primary-source review. The Digital Cash page promises future monthly external attestations but no eMXN report was located on the reviewed pages. Expected GENIUS effective date remains January 18, 2027; MSB registration does not confer PPSI approval.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS approval, state-qualified status or official pending application naming Telcoin LLC/eMXN was found in the opened issuer, OCC, Nebraska and Treasury materials or exact-name regulator searches. Nebraska charter and June 23 GENIUS-compliant-yield discussion concern the different eUSD issuer. No U.S. action naming this issuer was located in the recorded enforcement searches or OFAC 2026 chart. This scoped nondiscovery does not prove no confidential application exists or adjudicate Nebraska regime comparability.
